name: PickPair – Product Bundles, Frequently Bought Together, Cart Upsell & Checkout Order Bump for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Stop Installing 5 Separate Plugins Just to Increase Your WooCommerce Order Value.

If you want customers to buy more than one item in your WooCommerce store, you normally have to install one plugin for product bundles, another for Frequently Bought Together boxes, a third for cart upsells, a fourth for checkout order bumps, and a fifth for thank you page coupons. That slows down your site and costs too much to manage.

PickPair gives you all of them inside one fast, lightweight WooCommerce plugin.

Without writing a single line of code, you can show Amazon-style Frequently Bought Together recommendations on product pages, sell discounted product bundles, trigger add-to-cart popups, recommend cross-sells in the cart, add one-click order bumps at checkout, and send next-order coupons on the Thank You page.

Visit Official Website | See All Features | View Pricing & Plans | Get Support

Why WooCommerce Store Owners Choose PickPair

  • Replace 5 Plugins With 1: Run product bundles, Frequently Bought Together, cart upsells, checkout bumps, popups, free shipping bars, and post-purchase offers from one dashboard.
  • One-Click No-Reload Cart Additions: Shoppers can check the items they want and add entire bundles or order bumps to their cart instantly via AJAX without reloading the page.
  • Full Discount Control: Offer percentage discounts, fixed amount discounts, or a single flat price for a bundle. You can apply bundle discounts to the main trigger product, the add-on items, or both.
  • Works With Modern WooCommerce Blocks: Fully compatible with both classic WooCommerce cart/checkout shortcodes and the new WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Gutenberg Blocks.
  • Smart Display & Targeting Rules: Show offers based on specific products, categories, cart subtotals, user roles, login status, or whether the shopper has bought from you before.
  • Built-In Revenue Analytics: See exactly how many views, clicks, orders, and extra sales each campaign brings in.
  • Zero Storefront Bloat: Frontend scripts load only on the pages where an active offer is running, keeping your store and checkout fast.

Cover Every Step of Your Customer’s Buying Journey

Most shoppers buying a phone do not go hunting through your catalog to find the right phone case, screen protector, or warranty. They need to see those items at the exact moment they are ready to buy. PickPair lets you place targeted offers at every stage of your store funnel:

1. On the Product Page (Before They Add to Cart)

  • Frequently Bought Together: Display an Amazon-style box right on the product page showing items that go together. Customers tick the checkboxes they want and add everything to the cart in one click.
  • Product Bundles: Group 2 or more related products into a package deal at a percentage off, a fixed discount, or a flat bundle price (for example, a Cleanser + Toner + Moisturizer skincare kit for $49).
  • Product Page Add-ons: Let shoppers add simple one-click extras to an item, such as gift wrapping, custom engraving, or an extended warranty.

2. The Moment They Click “Add to Cart”

  • Add-to-Cart Popup Offers: Catch the shopper’s attention right as they add an item to their cart with a clean popup suggesting a matching accessory or special deal.

3. Inside the Cart Page or Cart Drawer

  • Cart Upsells & Cross-Sells: Recommend complementary items or product upgrades while the shopper is reviewing their cart.
  • Cart Add-ons: Offer whole-order extras like priority order handling or gift packaging with a single click.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar: Show buyers how much more they need to spend to unlock free shipping, encouraging them to add one more product to their cart.

4. On the Checkout Page (Right Before Payment)

  • One-Click Checkout Order Bumps: Place a compact, high-converting offer box right next to the payment section. Shoppers tick one box to add an impulse item, protection plan, or rush shipping without leaving checkout.

5. On the Thank You Page (After Checkout)

  • Post-Purchase Offers: Show a special one-time deal on the order confirmation page right after checkout is completed.
  • Next Order Coupons: Automatically generate a personalized discount coupon for the customer’s next purchase, complete with an expiration date and custom brand colors to turn first-time buyers into repeat customers.

Smart Pricing, Stock & Currency Controls

PickPair is built for real WooCommerce catalog management so your margins and inventory stay protected:

  • Target Your Bundle Discounts: Choose whether a Frequently Bought Together discount applies to the main product, the recommended add-on items, or the entire bundle.
  • Sale Price vs. Regular Price Rules: Decide whether campaign discounts calculate from a product’s regular price or its active WooCommerce sale price.
  • Out-of-Stock Bundle Protection: Automatically prevent a bundle from being purchased if any required item inside the bundle runs out of stock.
  • Automatic Self-Exclusion: If a customer already has an item or is viewing it, PickPair never recommends that same product as its own add-on.
  • Multi-Currency Support: Works smoothly with supported WooCommerce multi-currency conversion plugins for international stores.

Target Offers So Customers Only See What Fits

Showing the same generic upsell to every visitor does not convert. PickPair lets you set precise rules for every campaign:

  • Product & Category Rules: Trigger offers only when specific products or categories are being viewed or are inside the cart.
  • Cart Value Conditions: Show an offer only when the cart total is above or below a specific amount (for example, offer a discounted accessory on orders over $50).
  • Customer & Role Targeting: Display different offers to guest visitors, logged-in customers, wholesale roles, or VIP members.
  • Past Purchase History: Target returning customers based on their previous orders, or show a special welcome bundle to first-time buyers.
  • Flexible Page Placement: Choose the exact position where your offer widget appears on product, cart, and checkout pages so it matches your theme cleanly.

Real-World Examples You Can Set Up in Minutes

  • Electronics & Gadgets: Show a Frequently Bought Together box on a camera page with a memory card and carrying bag at 10% off, then offer a 2-year warranty as a checkout order bump.
  • Clothing & Apparel: When a shopper adds a dress or jacket to their cart, show a cart cross-sell for a matching belt or handbag.
  • Health, Beauty & Supplements: Bundle 3 bottles or a 3-step routine together at a flat bundle price to double your average order value on the product page.
  • Pet Supplies: Trigger an add-to-cart popup offering discounted pet treats whenever a customer adds a bag of pet food to their cart.
  • Digital Products & Courses: Offer a companion workbook or template pack as a one-click checkout order bump or Thank You page offer.
  • Any WooCommerce Store: Display a Next Order Coupon on the Thank You page that expires in 14 days to bring buyers back for a second order.

Track Every Sale With Built-In Campaign Reports

Stop guessing which offers are actually making money. PickPair includes a clean analytics dashboard inside WordPress that tracks:

  • Total extra revenue generated by PickPair across your store
  • Campaign-by-campaign breakdown of views, clicks, conversion rates, and revenue earned
  • Quick search, sorting, and filtering so you can see your top-performing bundles and order bumps at a glance

Explore all features on the PickPair features page or compare plan options on the pricing page.

Privacy

PickPair uses WooCommerce store data to determine which offers to display. Depending on the conditions configured by the store administrator, the plugin may check cart contents, cart totals, customer login status and previous orders.

The campaign reports feature records offer views, clicks and sales. The Next Order Coupon feature creates a coupon for a customer’s next purchase after an order is placed.

Store administrators are responsible for reviewing their site’s data collection and processing practices, maintaining an appropriate privacy policy and complying with applicable privacy requirements.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for PickPair.
  4. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.
  5. Click PickPair in your left-hand WordPress menu to launch your first campaign.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the PickPair plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file, click Install Now, and activate the plugin.

How to Create Your First High-Converting Offer in 2 Minutes

  1. Go to PickPair > Campaigns and click to create a new campaign.
  2. Select Frequently Bought Together (for product pages) or Checkout Order Bump (for the checkout page).
  3. Pick the product you want to recommend, set an optional discount (such as 10% off), and click Publish.
  4. Visit your store to see the offer live, and check PickPair > Reports after a few days to track your extra sales.
sections.faq:
How do I create Amazon-style Frequently Bought Together bundles in WooCommerce?

Install PickPair, create a new Frequently Bought Together campaign, choose your main trigger product, and select the matching products you want to recommend alongside it. You can offer them at regular price or add a percentage, fixed, or flat discount. Customers can check the items they want and add them all to the cart in one click.

Can I choose whether the bundle discount applies to the main product or only the add-on items?

Yes. In Frequently Bought Together campaigns, you can apply the discount to the trigger product only, the recommended add-on products only, or both.

How do I add a one-click order bump on the WooCommerce checkout page?

Create a Checkout Order Bump campaign in PickPair, select the product or service you want to offer (such as gift wrapping, priority shipping, or a small accessory), and choose your targeting rules. A clean offer box will appear on the checkout page where buyers can add it to their order with a single click before paying.

Does PickPair work with the new WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks?

Yes. PickPair works out of the box with both classic WooCommerce [woocommerce_cart] and [woocommerce_checkout] shortcodes and the modern WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Gutenberg Blocks.

Will PickPair slow down my WooCommerce website?

No. PickPair only loads its frontend scripts on pages where an active offer campaign is displayed. It is also built to work smoothly with caching plugins like WP Rocket and LiteSpeed Cache.

What is the difference between Product Bundles and Frequently Bought Together?

Product Bundles group items together as a fixed package deal (buy all of these together to get the bundle price). Frequently Bought Together lets the shopper customize their selection by checking or unchecking individual recommended items before clicking “Add Selected to Cart.” PickPair includes both.

Can I offer one-click add-ons like gift wrap or an extended warranty?

Yes. You can use Product Add-ons on individual product pages, Cart Add-ons on the cart page, or Checkout Order Bumps at checkout to offer extra services or warranties in one click.

Can I show upsells or cross-sells based on what is already in the customer’s cart?

Yes. You can set targeting rules based on specific products in the cart, product categories, minimum or maximum cart subtotals, user roles, login status, and past customer orders.

What happens if one of the products in a bundle goes out of stock?

You can enable stock protection so that if any required item inside a bundle goes out of stock, the bundle is automatically prevented from being purchased.

Does PickPair support multi-currency stores?

Yes. PickPair includes multi-currency support for supported WooCommerce currency switcher plugins. You can also choose whether offer discounts calculate from the regular price or the current sale price.

Can I automatically send a coupon for the customer’s next order?

Yes. The Next Order Coupon campaign generates a discount coupon on the Thank You page after checkout, with customizable expiry dates, colors, and minimum spend rules to encourage repeat orders.

How do I track how much revenue PickPair generates for my store?

Go to PickPair > Reports in your WordPress dashboard to view total extra revenue, impressions, clicks, and conversion counts for every campaign you run.

Where can I get support or see plan options?

You can ask questions in the WordPress.org support forum, visit the PickPair website, compare plans on the pricing page, or contact our team on the support page.
